name: Baked Cauliflower
description: A creamy baked cauliflower casserole with cheese, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cauliflower in boiling water and salt for 10 minutes.
In a casserole dish, stir together undiluted soup, cheese, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
Add cauliflower and mix well.
Toss bread crumbs in melted butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 250°F until bubbly.

_similar.name: Cauliflower Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A versatile casserole recipe that can use either cauliflower or broccoli, topped with croutons and Parmesan cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the chosen vegetable in the microwave for 2 minutes.
Add cream of celery soup, mayonnaise, and cheese to the cooked vegetable. Mix well.
Add croutons to the mixture.
Spread cracker crumbs on top of the casserole.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the mixture.
Put butter pieces on top of the mixture.
Cook at 350°F for 40 minutes.

_similar.keywords: cauliflower casserole, broccoli casserole, cheesy vegetable bake

_similar.name: Cauliflower Christmas
_similar.description: A layered cauliflower dish with Swiss cheese, green peppers, and mushrooms, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the green peppers and mushrooms in butter until tender.
Add flour to the sautéed mixture and stir to combine.
Gradually stir in milk, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Remove from heat and add shredded cheese, stirring until melted.
In a greased baking dish, layer half of the cauliflower.
Top with half of the cheese sauce and half of the pimiento.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining cauliflower and sauce.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake uncovered at 325°F for 25 minutes.

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side
